comparison.objective: Set a grinder, pour beans into its intake, and turn its crank; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Selector adjustment, bulk pouring, and crank operation versus selective screening with orientation-dependent passage and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Beans retained in grinder, crank rotated, cup returned versus ≥98% media recovered while washers remain in the screen.
comparison.reason: Bulk dry pouring overlaps, but the grinder task lacks mixed-population retention and selective aperture flow.
